type User {
  id: Int!
  name: String!
  about(
    asHtml: Boolean
  ): String
  avatar: UserAvatar
  bannerImage: String
  isFollowing: Boolean
  isFollower: Boolean
  isBlocked: Boolean
  bans: Json
  options: UserOptions
  mediaListOptions: MediaListOptions
  favourites(
    page: Int
  ): Favourites
  statistics: UserStatisticTypes
  unreadNotificationCount: Int
  siteUrl: String
  donatorTier: Int
  donatorBadge: String
  moderatorRoles: [ModRole]
  createdAt: Int
  updatedAt: Int
  stats: UserStats @deprecated
  moderatorStatus: String @deprecated
  previousNames: [UserPreviousName]
}
